title: Code node body-enrich did NOT reproduce 0.385 to 0.647 lift on current code: recall-neutral-to-negative due to codebase drift evidence chunk 2
summary:
RE-MEASURED on isolated daemon :8799 (temp ORCH_DATA, models junction, two workspaces on one daemon isolating ONLY the embed representation), 13-query first-party locate(/search k=8)+fetch(code_node file:line, top-6, 12k cap, recall=relevant∩identifier-tokens, tokens=ceil/4). Result is STABLE/deterministic (identical on re-run):
  first-party shipped/thin : recall 0.506-0.532, ~1160 tok, 833 tok/correct, 9/13 hits
  first-party enriched     : recall 0.4744,      1264 tok, 568 tok/correct, 8/13 hits
The enrichment did NOT reach ~0.64 — it was recall-NEUTRAL-to-NEGATIVE (slightly LOWER), though it improved token economy (tok/correct 833->568) and DID flip the proof's predicted gains q08 0->1.0, q10->0.75, q12->0.75, q13->0.667. But it REGRESSED q02/q03/q11 (1.0->0).
